name: Cart
overview: The Scriptures in 1 Samuel 6:7-12 describe the use of a cart in the context of returning the ark of the LORD by the Philistines. A new cart was made, yoked to two untrained milch kine, and the ark was placed upon it along with a trespass offering of gold. The kine’s direct and unerring path to Bethshemesh demonstrated God's sovereign hand in the event, confirming that the calamities upon the Philistines were from the LORD and not chance. This passage highlights how God used ordinary means like a cart and untrained animals to accomplish His divine purposes and reveal His will to His people.
